t: This is the Lord's Media Centre, the building that houses the press at Lord's Cricket Ground in St John's Wood. Lord's is home to Middlesex County Cricket Club and the England and Wales Cricket Board, and it is owned by the Marylebone Cricket Club. The media centre was designed by Amanda Levete, while she was a partner at Future Systems. Their work on this building won the 1999 Stirling Prize. Levete now leads her own practice, AL_A, and was appointed CBE in 2017.
